note: The creator's revisions to the approved storyboard, applied by scripts/build_timelines.py before anything else. Trims: a beat's source window in the recording starts later or ends earlier; the words outside the window leave the clock, every other anchor is kept, and the beats that follow move up by the time removed. A handle is extra media cut into the excerpt file beyond the window (for a dissolve); the beat's shot then starts src_in = head_handle_s into its file. Transitions: a cross dissolve into a beat, centred on the cut, half its length borrowed from each side. Times are whole frames at 30 fps; the excerpts and takes are cut by scripts/cut_excerpts.sh to match.

trims.why: The opening 'So we all know that' is cut; the beat starts on 'for example'. The cut sits in the pause after 'that'.
The window ran 11 frames into the next word ('because'); it now ends in the closure before it, after 'smaller'. The excerpt carries half a second more picture for the dissolve that follows.
The first 17 frames held a word fragment and a click; the beat starts just before 'interval'. The excerpt carries half a second of picture before that for the dissolve.

transitions.name: Cross Dissolve
transitions.why: The cut from beat 3 to beat 4 joins two moments of the same framing; a one-second dissolve softens the jump.
